key.name: exit-mode
key.summary: How a session can be stopped early: sentence, wait or none

key.name: exit-sentence
key.default: 'I choose to set down my {task} before the bell.'
key.summary: Sentence to type to stop early ({task} becomes the mode name)

key.name: exit-wait-seconds
key.summary: Seconds to wait before stopping early

key.name: durations
key.summary: Session lengths offered in the menu, in minutes

key.name: modes
key.summary: Modes as JSON: name, allowed apps, browser to watch, required tab title

key.name: always-allowed
key.summary: Apps allowed in every mode (file pickers and similar)

key.name: panel-display
key.summary: What the top bar shows during a sitting: icon, minutes or full

key.name: mute-notifications
key.summary: Hide notification banners during a session

key.name: tab-bar-height
key.summary: Height in pixels left uncovered at the top of a browser window, so its tabs stay clickable

key.name: track-reading-progress
key.summary: Report pages read in Zotero (Ethereal Style reading-progress.json) at the end of a session

key.name: reading-progress-path
key.summary: Path to reading-progress.json (empty means ~/Zotero/reading-progress.json)

key.name: blocked-sites
key.summary: Sites (matched in the tab title) covered on a No-site day

key.name: browsers
key.summary: Browsers watched on a No-site day

key.name: every-day-site-block
key.summary: Make every day a No-site day

key.name: site-day
key.summary: Date (YYYY-MM-DD) declared as a No-site day; it lasts until midnight

key.name: active-mode
key.summary: JSON snapshot of the running session's mode (empty when idle)

key.name: session-start
key.summary: Unix time the session started

key.name: session-end
key.summary: Unix time the session ends

key.name: session-exit-mode
key.summary: Exit mode fixed at the start of the running session

key.name: session-counters
key.summary: JSON: windows minimized and tabs covered in the running sitting

key.name: muted-banners
key.summary: Whether this extension turned notification banners off
